summary: Bounded global index/value setter. Reads an upper bound by passing dword_8AFE64 to SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0, then, when the requested index a1 is below that bound, stores a1 into dword_8AFE6C and stores the value retrieved for that index via BoundedArrayAccessor_bfd0 into dword_8AFE68. Returns the bound when the guard fails, otherwise the retrieved value.

operations.description: Read the upper bound by passing dword_8AFE64 to SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0.
Guard on the requested index a1: it must be strictly less than the bound retrieved from dword_8AFE64 for the writes to occur.
Store the requested index a1 into dword_8AFE6C.
Read the value at index a1 through BoundedArrayAccessor_bfd0.
Store the value retrieved for the index into dword_8AFE68.
Return the retrieved value on success, or the bound when the index was out of range.
